framings.text: You want to be the final human judge of a durable, cohesive development experience that carries intuition through to a trustworthy, review-ready change while preserving the health and future ease of the codebase.

supports.quote: it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.

it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier.

framings.text: You want a human-first coordinating harness spanning the agentic software-development lifecycle, with rigor, verification, and durability that compound across the harness and the codebases it helps change.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness.
a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
that has the rigor and durability and cohesive and verification that all 'just work's and thinks about the future of any code base it works on.

outcome: You experience a coherent, trustworthy path from an initial hunch to a human-reviewable change, while judging the finished result and seeing the codebase become healthier and easier to change.

questions.text: At what points do you want to intervene before judging the finished result?

alternatives.label: Human-first lifecycle board
alternatives.benefit: Makes the full journey visible, coordinated, and verifiable while preserving your role as final judge.
alternatives.cost: May require substantial modeling and upkeep across many lifecycle stages.

alternatives.label: Compounding review-and-change workflow
alternatives.benefit: Focuses repeatable feedback on healthier, increasingly easier-to-change code.
alternatives.cost: May provide less visibility across the broader coordination experience.
